headline: Year-Round Coastal Access with Dusk Restrictions
reservation: Access to the site is open all year round, though the beach is restricted after 9 PM or dusk. Visitors should check the official Lulworth Estate website for current parking hours and potential accessibility updates before arrival.

days.title: Jurassic Limestone and Merged Bays
days.start: Suggested: 10 AM at the Durdle Door access path; check current access hours

stops.name: Durdle Door
stops.detail: View the iconic 10,000-year-old stone arch and isolated sea stacks that mark the ancient coastline.

stops.name: Man O’War beach
stops.detail: Descend the steps to view the tilted Purbeck Beds and wave-cut notches in the chalk cliffs.

days.driving: Allow for local walking time between the cliff path and beaches; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: Stay clear of the caves at the base of the chalk cliffs as falls are common.

intel.title: Beach Curfews
intel.text: Access to the beach areas is not permitted after 9 PM or dusk. Ensure you have planned your return to the cliff top accordingly.

intel.title: Geological Interpretation
intel.text: An interpretation panel is located at the top of the steps to explain the formation of the merged bays. Use this to understand the local geography before descending.

plan.arrival: Use the official directions for Durdle Door and review current access information before descending the cliff path. Do not enter the caves below the chalk cliffs.
plan.vehicle: Check actual rental and local road restrictions before travel, and confirm parking suitability with the operator before bringing a larger vehicle.
plan.goldenHour: Durdle Door is a possible photography stop during permitted access hours; choose light to suit the season and leave before the beach access cutoff.
